title: BNMMLU: Measuring Massive Multitask Language Understanding in Bengali
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured knowledge of comparative religion, including theology, world religions, and ethical teachings, as one of 41 subject domains.
findings: In the domain of 'Comparative Religion', models generally achieved high accuracy, classifying the subject as 'easy'. However, there was high variance in performance across different models, indicating inconsistency in their knowledge of the topic.
